cases.name: Historical upper v0.2: high-resistance joints sensitivity

assumptions: Historical full-band calculations use upper a5acd2a0ca0a0134b26fcce2757d164a1250080bb73f65dd778f97ea8f821d2f, not the new insertion tail. Do not treat their full-loop totals as current. Unchanged lower/gimbal geometry retains its original provenance.
Full simultaneous screening current 0.2 A per W/N/C channel, 0.6 A zone positive; actual LED current unmeasured.
Nominal tape nameplate arithmetic is only 0.158 A per four-strip zone; screening above intentionally larger.
Strip rail and contact resistances are authored sensitivity inputs, not measured values.
One feed, four equal constant-current distributed loads; no claim of nonlinear LED/driver simulation.
Other controller, cable and connector drops are not included in 0.72 V comparison; retain budget for them.
The extreme joint case is a sensitivity, not an acceptable production operating point.
0.75 A motor DC / 0.333 A LED-pair assumptions; motor start/stall/regeneration and CAN require bench checks.
Conductor temperature is an INPUT; these calculations do not predict enclosure temperature or ampacity.

mechanical.why: Adhesive thickness variation alone can move far-end pad alignment by 0.346 mm, exceeding the nominal 0.30 mm lateral copper margin before assembly/fab errors. Dry-fit the template at the actual compressed mounting radius; if it misses, regenerate geometry with the measured stack. Do not force or stretch the flex.
